units.source_text: 众人聚集一堂，源氏主人出来就座，与尚侍会面。

en.t: Everyone gathered in one hall, and Genji, their host, came out, took his seat, and met with the Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 源氏容貌昳丽，宛若青年。

en.t: Genji's features were beautiful, as if he were still a young man.

units.source_text: 其娇艳之相，使人疑心这四十祝寿是算错了年岁。

en.t: His radiant beauty made people wonder whether the years had been miscounted for this fortieth-birthday celebration.

units.source_text: 他不像是做了父亲的人。

en.t: He did not look like a man who had become a father.

units.source_text: 玉鬘与他久别重逢，一见不胜羞涩。

en.t: Tamakazura, seeing him again after a long separation, was overcome with shyness at first glance.

units.source_text: 但也并不明显表示疏隔之相，仍是亲切地罄谈衷曲。

en.t: Yet she showed no obvious air of distance, and still spoke with him warmly, pouring out what was in her heart.

units.source_text: 玉鬘所生的两个孩子都很可爱。

en.t: The two children Tamakazura had borne were both very charming.

units.source_text: 玉鬘结婚未久，连生二孩，怕难为情，不肯一齐带去给源氏看。

en.t: Tamakazura had married only recently and had borne two children in quick succession, so, feeling embarrassed, she was unwilling to take them both together to show Genji.

units.source_text: 但髭黑大将说机会难得，定要带二孩同去拜见。

en.t: But General Higekuro said the opportunity was rare and insisted on taking both children with them to pay their respects.

units.source_text: 两孩都穿便装，头发左右分开。

en.t: The two children were both dressed in everyday clothes, with their hair parted to the left and right.

units.source_text: 源氏见了，说道：“年龄增长，自己心中并无特别感觉，

en.t: Seeing them, Genji said, "As the years increase, I myself feel nothing special in my heart;

units.source_text: 只管同从前年轻时候一样度日子，并无变更。

en.t: I simply go on living just as I did when I was young, with nothing changed.

units.source_text: 但看见了这些孙儿，便觉自己已经年老，有时不免感慨。

en.t: But when I see these grandchildren, I feel that I have already grown old, and at times I cannot help being moved by it.

units.source_text: 夕雾也已生了孩子，只因居处隔远，我还不曾见过呢。

en.t: Yugiri too has already had a child, but because he lives far away, I have not yet seen the child.

units.source_text: 你比别人关心我的年龄，于今天这日子首先来此祝寿，叫我一则以喜，一则以惧。

en.t: You care about my age more than others do, and on this day you came here first to offer your birthday congratulations, which makes me both glad and apprehensive.

units.source_text: 我正想暂且把老忘记呢。”

en.t: I had just been thinking that, for a while, I would forget about old age."

units.source_text: 玉鬘已是一个二十六岁的少妇，风度更增高雅，姿态十分秀美。

en.t: Tamakazura was now a young married woman of twenty-six; her bearing had grown still more elegant, and her figure was very graceful.
